---

The error has been fixed! The issue was that the `WebSocketChatInterface` component was being used in the template but wasn't imported in the script section. This caused the component refs (`userChatRef` and `agentChatRef`) to be undefined, so when `addGlobalMessage` tried to call `userChatRef.value?.addMessage()`, it threw the "is not a function" error.

I've added the missing import statement:

```typescript
import WebSocketChatInterface from './WebSocketChatInterface.vue'
```

Now the component is properly imported and the refs should work correctly. The `addGlobalMessage` function will be able to access the `addMessage` method on both chat interface components as intended.
